notes: A tenant cell merged across two rows (e.g. one tenant leasing two adjacent suites, shown once visually) -- openpyxl reports the second physical row's tenant cell as blank. Correct/safe behavior is skipping that row (losing a real second unit) rather than fabricating a tenant name for it; documented as a real, known limitation of the merged-cell case, not silently wrong data.

rows.skip_reason: merged-cell continuation row -- tenant cell is genuinely blank (openpyxl only returns a value on the merge's anchor cell)
